scope: All twelve native Canvas captures, three effects, both player slots, emission and flight
observations: Floatstinger: diffuse olive/yellow-brown cloud visible at emission and after twelve ticks in both orientations; transparent edges without an opaque rectangular background.

Asphyxia: dark gray/brown plume with lighter trailing wisps visible in both orientations. Existing emitter is around torso/waist height; this review does not certify a mouth attachment or exact original anatomy.

Immolator: yellow-orange flame visible in both orientations. At the first emission the existing body partly occludes the effect; after twelve ticks the flame is clearly visible in front of it. Exact nozzle/head attachment and original stream length are not established.
Existing actor art, pose, HUD, projectile radius, lifetime, speed and vertical offset are unchanged. The stationary attack body pose is not a new animation.
limits: Native Canvas is not browser, HTTP, DOM or service-worker verification.
